descriptor_lifetime.completion: under lock recheck same live generation/snapshot before cache insert or acceptance
descriptor_lifetime.finally: kill/reap unfinished child; close own duplicate; release own slot exactly once on every outcome
descriptor_lifetime.owner: slot owner exclusively retains duplicate through inheritance and child completion; close never steals reservation
descriptor_lifetime.shutdown: mark stopped clear cache under lock, release lock then cancel/reap via owners and wake waiters; wait for cleanup before shutdown-complete
descriptor_lifetime.waiters: hold no fd; obtain parser slot before lifetime lock duplicate and recheck

identity.admission: All admissions use same private immutable ConfigSnapshot; under lifetime lock transient dup/fstat/object/size/seals and snapshot/generation live checks; cache hits release transient before return.
cache_key: entire immutable ConfigSnapshot equality or canonical digest
identity.execute: Reserved inherited duplicate through reviewed absolute prlimit; execute same object by /proc/self/fd/N; never disk fallback.
identity.init: Trusted-size regular-file bounded copy in supervised one-shot initializer, then seal WRITE/GROW/SHRINK/SEAL, hash final sealed destination and validate private single-fd transfer; see initialization and contract.md r2.

initialization.deadline: one supervised short-lived initializer; parent wall5s; CPU6s AS256MiB core0; no gate publication before success
initialization.final_identity: hash sealed destination AFTER all required seals, require trusted digest/size; strict one-fd transfer and parent metadata/seal validation
initialization.ownership: exactly one source/image/private SCM_RIGHTS transfer set; close all own/unexpected received descriptors on every path; kill/reap deadline helper
initialization.source: O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW and regular-file only; reject early EOF/excess, fstat not a bound
initialization.tcb: initializer code, SCM_RIGHTS validation and OS supervision; not proved by Lean
